name: Camden "Cam" Bedinghaus

items.why: The editorial is an opinion about his social media presence and political leanings. It cites no specific conduct, ethics or legal finding, or abuse of office, so it doesn't bear on any criterion.

for_review: I read the Bradenton Times editorial, and it names no specific posts or incidents behind the 'culture-war baggage' line. Other coverage (Florida Trib, Your Observer, WUSF) only notes he directs Turning Point USA Manatee County, posts about Charlie Kirk, and is a conservative who says he wants politics out of schools. I found no ethics, legal or financial matter. I did one search for him with the owner's named sites (alexjoneslive.com, stewpeters.com, ryandawson.org, infowars.com) and found nothing about him. A reviewer could check his social media posts directly, and check campaign finance filings (a Tea Party Manatee/Manatee Patriots contribution of about $300 was reported by a local Substack, which I did not verify). Since he won the Nov. 3 election, any record from his time on the board is not yet available.
